verdict.rationale: Docs show multiple concrete distribution paths: committing SKILL.md files directly into a project (.claude/skills), packaging skills into plugins that can be versioned and shared 'across projects and teams', and publishing/installing via git-based plugin marketplaces (`/plugin marketplace add`, `/plugin install`) with centralized discovery and automatic updates; the anthropics/skills GitHub repo itself demonstrates this pattern end-to-end. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of a team actually adopting a shared marketplace at scale (community evidence found focuses on skill-triggering reliability, not distribution mechanics).
